caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with drop-leaf sides, rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter tones to suggest wood grain and depth. The tabletop is rectangular, and the leaves hang down on either side, attached to the main surface with visible hinges. The front of the table features a single drawer, ornamented with a circular metallic handle in the center and decorative yellow-gold inlays on both ends of the drawer front. The four legs are straight and slightly tapered, each accented with lighter-colored decorative patterns running vertically. The table sits on a blank, cream-colored background, and the drawing is outlined by a thin, double rectangular border. The artist's signature, “Bernard Gussow,” is located in the lower left corner.
title: Drop-leaf Table
